name: incident-dispatch-card
intent: Calm ops dashboard is interrupted when a torn incident card slides in from the edge with a heavy CRITICAL badge.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Card appears in final position immediately; dashboard dims without slide

acceptance: Idle: calm dashboard with DISPATCH enabled
Dispatch: card slides from frozen off-screen distance over 660ms
Tear edge uses frozen jagged polygon path
CRITICAL badge is ink block with 3px border — not text-only
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows card in final pose immediately
No network; effect clipped to host
waveC: Torn edge + slide distance frozen via CSS vars; CRITICAL badge given heavy stamp weight
